author: jelyssacooper

item.authorHandle: jelyssacooper
item.caption:
I voted. Have you?

The 15th Amendment gave Black men the right to vote. The 19th Amendment gave it to women. Neither came quietly, and neither came easy. People marched, organized, went to jail and died so this could be ordinary for me.

So I vote every time, for everyone who could not.

I voted. Have you?

#ivoted #vote #civicduty #yourvotematters #santaclaracounty

author: donjake

item.authorHandle: donjake
item.caption:
Tomorrow is Election Day, and if you’re feeling the weight of the anxiety, frustration, and noise in the air—you are not alone. 🗳️🕊️

When cultural tension is at its peak, it’s easy to let fear dictate our reactions. But our ultimate peace doesn’t hinge on election returns or political cycles. We’re called to respond with something radically different: • Anchoring our security in God’s sovereignty
• Choosing countercultural grace over internet outrage
• Trading passive worry for proactive prayer
• Loving our actual neighbors regardless of how they vote.

Take a deep breath and head to
 the link in our bio for encouragement on how to walk through Election Day with clarity and faith.
#FaithOverFear #ElectionDay #ChristianFaith #KingdomFirst #GraceOverOutrage #BiblicalWorldview #PeaceOverPanic #ChristianBlog

author: teresasalas_realestate

item.authorHandle: teresasalas_realestate
item.caption:
🇺🇸🗳️ Today, I voted for the very first time! ❤️

I had been procrastinating, telling myself, “I’ll just go vote tomorrow in person.” But today, something changed my mind.

I came across a video of people placing their “I Voted” stickers on a memorial honoring a gentleman who lost his life at the hands of ICE agents. 💔 Seeing that video touched my heart deeply. It reminded me that behind every headline, every policy, and every decision, there are real people, real families, and real lives being affected.

That video was the push I needed. I stopped making excuses, grabbed my ballot, and went to drop it off. 🗳️

For the first time, I truly felt the importance of making my voice heard. Not just for myself, but for my children, my family, my community, and those whose voices can no longer be heard.

Today wasn’t just about casting my first ballot. It was about realizing that my voice matters, too. ❤️

I may have waited a long time to vote for the first time, but today I took that step, and it’s a moment I’ll always remember.

My first vote, but definitely not my last! 🇺🇸🗳️❤️

#MyFirstVote #MyVoiceMatters #IVoted #EveryVoiceMatters #Democracy
